status: Static v9 review: white limb colour correction only; retain existing design and copy

headline: Supplier said Tuesday.
It's Friday.
ART's on it.
slides.prompt: Your team shouldn't have to chase.
slides.scene_label: ART follows up while your team gets on with work.
slides.visual_logic: Mascot points to Tuesday/Friday overdue record.

headline: One late delivery.
A whole team waiting.
body: the next job waiting to start.
slides.prompt: The impact goes beyond the delivery.
slides.scene_label: The receiving tray is empty. The next job waits.
slides.visual_logic: Empty receiving tray and concerned mascot show the next job waiting.

headline: ART spots
what's overdue.
body: ART checks the promised delivery date
slides.prompt: Check what was due against what arrived.
slides.scene_label: The receiving record shows what is still missing.
slides.visual_logic: Magnifier and receiving records support the overdue check.

headline: "Any update?"
Already sent.
slides.prompt: Ask for a date. Keep track of the reply.
slides.scene_label: The follow-up is sent. ART now tracks the reply.
results: A new date has been requested.
The supplier has not replied yet.
slides.visual_logic: Mascot sends follow-up on phone; reply remains pending.

headline: When a reply comes in,
ART updates the record.
slides.prompt: Keep the reply with the delivery record.
slides.scene_label: The supplier's reply stays with the delivery record.
slides.visual_logic: Stylus/tablet illustrate the conditional reply-recording branch.

headline: No reply yet?
ART flags the delay.
body: ART alerts your team and shows
which work is waiting on the shipment.
slides.prompt: Bring unresolved delays to your team.
slides.scene_label: No reply yet. Your team can see what is held up.
slides.visual_logic: Raised flag and waiting folder illustrate the no-reply escalation branch.

headline: ART brings the details.
You decide what's next.
body: Wait, escalate or explore another supplier.
Your team has the details to decide.
slides.scene_label: The handover includes the details your team needs.
results: Your team decides the next step.
slides.visual_logic: Folder handover illustrates context passed to a human decision-maker.

headline: Keep work moving.
Let ART do the chasing.
body: ART (A Realtime Tech) handles delivery follow-ups
so your team can focus on the work ahead.
slides.scene_label: Less chasing. More time for your team.
slides.visual_logic: Relaxed mascot beside correspondence folders supports relief from follow-ups.
